sourceSentences: [0] Scion, if you lose your shield, you can't pop the W, of course.
[0] And then just make sure they can't break the shield before you pop W.
[0] I'm trying to kite away so I can get my W, but of course she breaks it. She doesn't want to take that damage for free.
[0] telegraphed, very easy to play around. If they can't see you a lot harder.
[0] Hit somebody with the E from two screens away. Boost at them with your approach velocity and they get a fully charged Q.
[0] But the ER just essentially allows your ulti to hit pretty much no matter what. Maybe if they have a dash or something, they can dodge, but if you hit the E, they're slowed.
[0] If my E hits, I'm alting. If my E misses, I'm not alting.
[1] En fait ce qui est vraiment le plus chiant excident c'est que quand il meurt ben il meurt pas vraiment.
[1] c'est son passif son passif le problème.
[2] Et en gros s'il il charge son truc, j'ai juste à lui mettre un E ou un silence et normalement en théorie il peut jamais charger sa grosse attaque.
[3] If the charge is interrupted, Decimating Smash is placed on a 2-second cooldown.
[3] Decimating Smash counters table: Disruption — Interrupted.
[3] If Decimating Smash was charged for at least 1 second (knock-up and stun applied).
[3] Soul Furnace can be recast while the shield holds, and does so automatically after the duration.
[3] Unstoppable Onslaught: crowd control cannot be applied during this time; Disruption does not interrupt it.
[3] Glory in Death: Sion can only move, basic attack and use item actives while in this state.
[3] Roar of the Slayer: a thrown minion or monster is not blocked by Wind Wall, unlike the initial projectile.
